1.text: Tha word of tha LORD dat came 2 Hosea, tha son of Beeri, in tha days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, N Hezekiah, kings of Judah, N in tha days of Jeroboam tha son of Joash, king of Israel.
Tha beginning of tha word of tha LORD by Hosea. N tha LORD said 2 Hosea, Go, take 2 u a wife of whoredoms N children of whoredoms: 4 tha land has committed great whoredom, departing from tha LORD.
So he went N took Gomer tha daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, N bare him a son.
N tha LORD said 2 him, Call his name Jezreel; 4 yet a little while, N I will avenge tha blood of Jezreel upon tha house of Jehu, N will cause 2 cease tha kingdom of tha house of Israel.
N it will happen at dat day, dat I will break tha bow of Israel in tha valley of Jezreel.
N she conceived again, N bare a daughter. N God said 2 him, Call her name look-ruhamah: 4 I will no more have mercy upon tha house of Israel; but I will utterly take ’em away.
But I will have mercy upon tha house of Judah, N will save ’em by tha LORD their God, N will not save ’em by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
Now when she had weaned look-ruhamah, she conceived, N bare a son.
Then said God, Call his name look-ammi: 4 y’all r not my people, N I will not be ur God.

Yet tha number of tha children of Israel shall be as tha sand of tha sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; N it will happen, dat in tha place where it was said 2 ’em, y’all r not my people, there it shall be said 2 ’em, y’all r tha sons of tha livin God.
Then shall tha children of Judah N tha children of Israel be gathered together, N appoint themselves one head, N dey shall come up out of tha land: 4 great shall be tha day of Jezreel.

2.text: Say y’all 2 ur brothers, Ammi; N 2 ur sisters, Ru-hamah.
Plead wit ur mother, plead: 4 she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, N her adulteries from between her breasts;
Lest I strip her naked, N set her as in tha day dat she was born, N make her as a wilderness, N set her like a dry land, N kill her wit thirst.
N I will not have mercy upon her children; 4 dey be tha children of whoredoms.
4 their mother has played tha harlot: she dat conceived ’em has done shamefully: 4 she said, I will go after my lovers, dat give me my bread N my water, my wool N my flax, mine oil N my drink.
Therefore, look, I will hedge up ur way wit thorns, N make a wall, dat she shall not find her paths.

N she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake ’em; N she shall seek ’em, but shall not find ’em: then shall she say, I will go N return 2 my first husband; 4 then was it better wit me than now.
4 she did not know dat I gave her corn, N wine, N oil, N multiplied her silver N gold, which dey prepared 4 Baal.
Therefore will I return, N take away my corn in tha time of it, N my wine in tha season of it, N will recover my wool N my flax given 2 cover her nakedness.
N now will I discover her lewdness in tha sight of her lovers, N none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
I will also cause all her mirth 2 cease, her feast days, her new moons, N her sabbaths, N all her solemn feasts.
N I will destroy her vines N her fig trees, whereof she has said, dese r my rewards dat my lovers have given me: N I will make ’em a forest, N tha beasts of tha field shall eat ’em.
N I will visit upon her tha days of Baalim, in which she burned incense 2 ’em, N she decked herself wit her earrings N her jewels, N she went after her lovers, N forgat me, says tha LORD.
Therefore, look, I will allure her, N bring her in2 tha wilderness, N speak comfortably 2 her.
N I will give her her vineyards from thence, N tha valley of Achor 4 a door of hope: N she shall sing there, as in tha days of her youth, N as in tha day when she came up out of tha land of Egypt.
N it will be at dat day, says tha LORD, dat u will call me Ishi; N will call me no more Baali.
4 I will take away tha namez of Baalim out of her mouth, N dey shall no more be remembered by their name.

N in dat day will I make a covenant 4 ’em wit tha beasts of tha field, N wit tha fowls of heaven, N wit tha creeping things of tha ground: N I will break tha bow N tha sword N tha battle out of tha earth, N will make ’em 2 lie down safely.
N I will betroth u 2 me 4 ever; yeah, I will betroth u 2 me in righteousness, N in judgment, N in lovingkindness, N in mercies.
I will even betroth u 2 me in faithfulness: N u will know tha LORD.
N it will happen in dat day, I will hear, says tha LORD, I will hear tha heavenz, N dey shall hear tha earth;
N tha earth shall hear tha corn, N tha wine, N tha oil; N dey shall hear Jezreel.
N I will sow her 2 me in tha earth; N I will have mercy upon her dat had not obtained mercy; N I will say 2 ’em which were not my people, u r my people; N dey shall say, u r my God.

3.text: Then said tha LORD 2 me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according 2 tha love of tha LORD toward tha children of Israel, who look 2 other gods, N love flagons of wine.
So I bought her 2 me 4 fifteen pieces of silver, N 4 an homer of barley, N an half homer of barley:
N I said 2 her, u will abide 4 me many days; u will not play tha harlot, N u will not be 4 another man: so will I also be 4 u.
4 tha children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, N without a prince, N without a sacrifice, N without an image, N without an ephod, N without teraphim:
Afterward shall tha children of Israel return, N seek tha LORD their God, N David their king; N shall fear tha LORD N his goodness in tha latter days.

4.text: Hear tha word of tha LORD, y’all children of Israel: 4 tha LORD has a controversy wit tha inhabitants of tha land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in tha land.
By swearing, N lyin, N killing, N stealing, N committing adultery, dey break out, N blood touches blood.
Therefore shall tha land mourn, N every one dat lives in it shall languish, wit tha beasts of tha field, N wit tha fowls of heaven; yeah, tha fishes of tha sea also shall be taken away.
Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: 4 ur people r as dey dat strive wit tha priest.
Therefore will u fall in tha day, N tha prophet also shall fall wit u in tha night, N I will destroy ur mother.

My people r destroyed 4 lack of knowledge: because u have rejected knowledge, I will also reject u, dat u will be no priest 2 me: seein u have forgotten tha law of ur God, I will also forget ur children.
As dey were increased, so dey sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory in2 shame.
Dey eat up tha sin of my people, N dey set their heart on their iniquity.
N there shall be, like people, like priest: N I will punish ’em 4 their ways, N reward ’em their doings.
4 dey shall eat, N not have enough: dey shall commit whoredom, N shall not increase: because dey have left off 2 pay attention 2 tha LORD.
Whoredom N wine N new wine take away tha heart.
My people ask counsel at their stocks, N their staff declareth 2 ’em: 4 tha spirit of whoredoms has caused ’em 2 err, N dey have gone a whoring from under their God.

Dey sacrifice upon tha tops of tha mountains, N burn incense upon tha hills, under oaks N poplars N elms, because tha shadow of it is good: therefore ur daughters shall commit whoredom, N ur spouses shall commit adultery.

I will not punish ur daughters when dey commit whoredom, nor ur spouses when dey commit adultery: 4 themselves r separated wit whores, N dey sacrifice wit harlots: therefore tha people dat does not understand shall fall.
Though u, Israel, play tha harlot, yet don’t let Judah offend; N come not y’all 2 Gilgal, neither go y’all up 2 Beth-aven, nor swear, tha LORD lives.
4 Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now tha LORD will feed ’em as a lamb in a large place.
Ephraim is joined 2 idols: let him alone.
Their drink is sour: dey have committed whoredom continually: her rulers wit shame do love, Give y’all.
Tha wind has bound her up in her wings, N dey shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

5.text: Hear y’all dis, O priests; N listen, y’all house of Israel; N give y’all ear, O house of tha king; 4 judgment is toward u, because y’all have been a snare on Mizpah, N a net spread upon Tabor.
N tha revolters r profound 2 make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of ’em all.
I know Ephraim, N Israel is not hid from me: 4 now, O Ephraim, u committest whoredom, N Israel is defiled.
Dey will not frame their doings 2 turn 2 their God: 4 tha spirit of whoredoms is in tha midst of ’em, N dey have not known tha LORD.
N tha pride of Israel does testify 2 his face: therefore shall Israel N Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall wit ’em.
Dey shall go wit their flocks N wit their herds 2 seek tha LORD; but dey shall not find him; he has withdrawn himself from ’em.
Dey have dealt treacherously against tha LORD: 4 dey have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour ’em wit their portions.
Blow y’all tha cornet in Gibeah, N tha trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after u, O Benjamin.
Ephraim shall be desolate in tha day of rebuke: among tha tribes of Israel have I made known dat which shall surely be.
Tha princes of Judah were like ’em dat remove tha bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon ’em like water.
Ephraim is oppressed N broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after tha commandment.
Therefore will I be 2 Ephraim as a moth, N 2 tha house of Judah as rottenness.
When Ephraim saw his sickness, N Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim 2 tha Assyrian, N sent 2 king Jareb: yet could he not heal u, nor cure u of ur wound.
4 I will be 2 Ephraim as a lion, N as a young lion 2 tha house of Judah: I, even I, will tear N go away; I will take away, N none shall rescue him.
I will go N return 2 my place, till dey acknowledge their offence, N seek my face: in their affliction dey will seek me early.

6.text: Come, N let us return 2 tha LORD: 4 he has torn, N he will heal us; he has struck, N he will bind us up.
After two days will he revive us: in tha third day he will raise us up, N we shall live in his sight.
Then shall we know, if we follow on 2 know tha LORD: his goin forth is prepared as tha morning; N he shall come 2 us as tha rain, as tha latter N former rain 2 tha earth.
O Ephraim, what shall I do 2 u? O Judah, what shall I do 2 u? 4 ur goodness is as a morning cloud, N as tha early dew it goes away.
Therefore have I hewed ’em by tha prophets; I have killed ’em by tha words of my mouth: N ur judgments r as tha light dat goes forth.
4 I desired mercy, N not sacrifice; N tha knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
But dey like men have transgressed tha covenant: there have dey dealt treacherously against me.
Gilead is a city of ’em dat work iniquity, N is polluted wit blood.
N as troops of robbers wait 4 a man, so tha company of priests murder in tha way by consent: 4 dey commit lewdness.
I have seen an horrible thing in tha house of Israel: there is tha whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
Also, O Judah, he has set an harvest 4 u, when I returned tha captivity of my people.

7.text: When I would have healed Israel, then tha iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, N tha wickedness of Samaria: 4 dey commit falsehood; N tha thief comes in, N tha troop of robbers spoileth without.
N dey consider not in their hearts dat I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset ’em about; dey r before my face.
Dey make tha king glad wit their wickedness, N tha princes wit their lies.
Dey r all adulterers, as an oven heated by tha baker, who ceases from raising after he has kneaded tha dough, until it be leavened.
In tha day of our king tha princes have made him sick wit bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand wit scorners.
4 dey have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles dey lie in wait: their baker sleeps all tha night; in tha morning it burns as a flaming fire.
Dey r all hot as an oven, N have devoured their judges; all their kings r fallen: there is none among ’em dat calls 2 me.
Ephraim, he has mixed himself among tha people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
Strangers have devoured his strength, N he knows it not: yeah, gray hairs r here N there upon him, yet he knows not.
N tha pride of Israel testifieth 2 his face: N dey do not return 2 tha LORD their God, nor seek him 4 all dis.
Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: dey call 2 Egypt, dey go 2 Assyria.
When dey shall go, I will spread my net upon ’em; I will bring ’em down as tha fowls of tha heaven; I will chastise ’em, as their congregation has heard.
Woe 2 ’em! 4 dey have fled from me: destruction 2 ’em! because dey have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed ’em, yet dey have spoken lies against me.
N dey have not cried 2 me wit their heart, when dey howled upon their beds: dey assemble themselves 4 corn N wine, N dey rebel against me.
Though I have bound N strengthened their arms, yet do dey imagine mischief against me.
Dey return, but not 2 tha most High: dey r like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by tha sword 4 tha rage of their tongue: dis shall be their derision in tha land of Egypt.

8.text: Set tha trumpet 2 ur mouth. He shall come as an eagle against tha house of tha LORD, because dey have transgressed my covenant, N trespassed against my law.
Israel shall cry 2 me, My God, we know u.
Israel has cast off tha thing dat is good: tha opp shall pursue him.
Dey have set up kings, but not by me: dey have made princes, N I knew it not: of their silver N their gold have dey made ’em idols, dat dey may be cut off.
Ur calf, O Samaria, has cast u off; mine anger is kindled against ’em: how long will it be ere dey attain 2 innocency?
4 from Israel was it also: tha workman made it; therefore it is not God: but tha calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
4 dey have sown tha wind, N dey shall reap tha whirlwind: it has no stalk: tha bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, tha strangers shall swallow it up.
Israel is swallowed up: now shall dey be among tha Gentiles as a vessel in which is no pleasure.
4 dey r gone up 2 Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim has hired lovers.
Yeah, though dey have hired among tha nations, now will I gather ’em, N dey shall sorrow a little 4 tha burden of tha king of princes.
Because Ephraim has made many altars 2 sin, altars shall be 2 him 2 sin.
I have written 2 him tha great things of my law, but dey were counted as a strange thing.
Dey sacrifice flesh 4 tha sacrifices of mine offerings, N eat it; but tha LORD accepteth ’em not; now will he remember their iniquity, N visit their sins: dey shall return 2 Egypt.
4 Israel has forgotten his Maker, N builds temples; N Judah has multiplied fenced citiez: but I will send a fire upon his citiez, N it shall devour tha palaces of it.

9.text: Rejoice not, O Israel, 4 joy, as other people: 4 u have gone a whoring from ur God, u have loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
Tha floor N tha winepress shall not feed ’em, N tha new wine shall fail in her.
Dey shall not live in tha LORD’s land; but Ephraim shall return 2 Egypt, N dey shall eat unclean things in Assyria.

Dey shall not offer wine offerings 2 tha LORD, neither shall dey be pleasing 2 him: their sacrifices shall be 2 ’em as tha bread of mourners; all dat eat of it shall be polluted: 4 their bread 4 their soul shall not come in2 tha house of tha LORD.
What will y’all do in tha solemn day, N in tha day of tha feast of tha LORD?
4, look, dey r gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather ’em up, Memphis shall bury ’em: tha pleasant places 4 their silver, nettles shall possess ’em: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
Tha days of visitation r come, tha days of recompence r come; Israel shall know it: tha prophet is a fool, tha spiritual man is mad, 4 tha crowd of thine iniquity, N tha great hatred.
Tha watchman of Ephraim was wit my God: but tha prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, N hatred in tha house of his God.
Dey have deeply corrupted themselves, as in tha days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

I found Israel like grapes in tha wilderness; I saw ur fathers as tha firstripe in tha fig tree at her first time: but dey went 2 Baal-peor, N separated themselves 2 dat shame; N their abominations were according as dey loved.
As 4 Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from tha birth, N from tha womb, N from tha conception.
Though dey bring up their children, yet will I bereave ’em, dat there shall not be a man left: yeah, woe also 2 ’em when I depart from ’em!
Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children 2 tha murderer.
Give ’em, O LORD: what will u give? give ’em a miscarrying womb N dry breasts.
All their wickedness is in Gilgal: 4 there I hated ’em: 4 tha wickedness of their doings I will drive ’em out of mine house, I will love ’em no more: all their princes r revolters.
Ephraim is struck, their root is dried up, dey shall bear no fruit: yeah, though dey bring forth, yet will I kill even tha beloved fruit of their womb.
My God will cast ’em away, because dey did not listen 2 him: N dey shall be wanderers among tha nations.

10.text: Israel is an empty vine, he brings forth fruit 2 himself: according 2 tha crowd of his fruit he has increased tha altars; according 2 tha goodness of his land dey have made goodly images.
Their heart is divided; now shall dey be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
4 now dey shall say, We have no king, because we feared not tha LORD; what then should a king do 2 us?
Dey have spoken words, swearing falsely in makin a covenant: like dis judgment springeth up as hemlock in tha furrows of tha field.

Tha inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of tha calves of Beth-aven: 4 tha people of it shall mourn over it, N tha priests of it dat rejoiced on it, 4 tha glory of it, because it is departed from it.
It shall be also carried 2 Assyria 4 a present 2 king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, N Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
As 4 Samaria, her king is cut off as tha foam upon tha water.
Tha high places also of Aven, tha sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: tha thorn N tha thistle shall come up on their altars; N dey shall say 2 tha mountains, Cover us; N 2 tha hills, Fall on us.
O Israel, u have sinned from tha days of Gibeah: there dey stood: tha battle in Gibeah against tha children of iniquity did not overtake ’em.
It is in my desire dat I should chastise ’em; N tha people shall be gathered against ’em, when dey shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
N Ephraim is as an heifer dat is taught, N loves 2 tread out tha corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim 2 ride; Judah shall plow, N Jacob shall break his clods.
Sow 2 y’all in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up ur fallow ground: 4 it is time 2 seek tha LORD, till he come N rain righteousness upon u.
y’all have plowed wickedness, y’all have reaped iniquity; y’all have eaten tha fruit of lies: because u did trust in ur way, in tha crowd of ur mighty men.
Therefore shall a tumult arise among ur people, N all ur fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in tha day of battle: tha mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
So shall Beth-el do 2 u because of ur great wickedness: in a morning shall tha king of Israel utterly be cut off.

11.text: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, N called my son out of Egypt.
As dey called ’em, so dey went from ’em: dey sacrificed 2 Baalim, N burned incense 2 graven images.
I taught Ephraim also 2 go, takin ’em by their arms; but dey knew not dat I healed ’em.
I drew ’em wit cords of a man, wit bands of love: N I was 2 ’em as dey dat take off tha yoke on their jaws, N I laid food 2 ’em.
He shall not return in2 tha land of Egypt, but tha Assyrian shall be his king, because dey refused 2 return.
N tha sword shall abide on his citiez, N shall consume his branches, N devour ’em, because of their own counsels.
N my people r bent 2 backsliding from me: though dey called ’em 2 tha most High, none at all would exalt him.
How shall I give u up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver u, Israel? how shall I make u as Admah? how shall I set u as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings r kindled together.
I will not execute tha fierceness of mine anger, I will not return 2 destroy Ephraim: 4 I am God, N not man; tha Holy One in tha midst of u: N I will not enter in2 tha city.
Dey shall walk after tha LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then tha children shall tremble from tha west.
Dey shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, N as a dove out of tha land of Assyria: N I will place ’em in their houses, says tha LORD.
Ephraim compasseth me about wit lies, N tha house of Israel wit deceit: but Judah yet rules wit God, N is faithful wit tha saints.

12.text: Ephraim feeds on wind, N follows after tha east wind: he daily increases lies N desolation; N dey do make a covenant wit tha Assyrians, N oil is carried in2 Egypt.
Tha LORD has also a controversy wit Judah, N will punish Jacob according 2 his ways; according 2 his doings will he recompense him.
He took his brother by tha heel in tha womb, N by his strength he had power wit God:
Yeah, he had power over tha angel, N prevailed: he wept, N made supplication 2 him: he found him in Beth-el, N there he spoke wit us;
Even tha LORD God of hosts; tha LORD is his memorial.
Therefore turn u 2 ur God: keep mercy N judgment, N wait on ur God continually.
He is a merchant, tha balances of deceit r in his hand: he loves 2 oppress.
N Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours dey shall find none iniquity in me dat were sin.
N I dat am tha LORD ur God from tha land of Egypt will yet make u 2 live in tabernacles, as in tha days of tha solemn feast.
I have also spoken by tha prophets, N I have multiplied visions, N used similitudes, by tha ministry of tha prophets.
Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely dey r vanity: dey sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yeah, their altars r as heaps in tha furrows of tha fields.
N Jacob fled in2 tha country of Syria, N Israel served 4 a wife, N 4 a wife he kept sheep.
N by a prophet tha LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, N by a prophet was he preserved.
Ephraim provoked him 2 anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, N his reproach shall his Lord return 2 him.

13.text: When Ephraim spoke tremblin, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

N now dey sin more N more, N have made ’em molten images of their silver, N idols according 2 their own understanding, all of it tha work of tha craftsmen: dey say of ’em, Let tha men dat sacrifice kiss tha calves.
Therefore dey shall be as tha morning cloud, N as tha early dew dat passes away, as tha chaff dat is driven wit tha whirlwind out of tha floor, N as tha smoke out of tha chimney.
Yet I am tha LORD ur God from tha land of Egypt, N u will know no god but me: 4 there is no saviour beside me.
I did know u in tha wilderness, in tha land of great drought.
According 2 their pasture, so were dey filled; dey were filled, N their heart was exalted; therefore have dey forgotten me.
Therefore I will be 2 ’em as a lion: as a leopard by tha way will I observe ’em:
I will meet ’em as a bear dat is bereaved of her whelps, N will rend tha caul of their heart, N there will I devour ’em like a lion: tha wild beast shall tear ’em.
O Israel, u have destroyed urself; but in me is thine help.
I will be ur king: where is any other dat may save u in all ur citiez? N ur judges of whom u said, Give me a king N princes?
I gave u a king in mine anger, N took him away in my wrath.
Tha iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
Tha sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; 4 he should not stay long in tha place of tha breaking forth of children.
I will ransom ’em from tha power of tha grave; I will redeem ’em from death: O death, I will be ur plagues; O grave, I will be ur destruction: repentance shall be hid from my eyes.

Though he be fruitful among his brothers, an east wind shall come, tha wind of tha LORD shall come up from tha wilderness, N his spring shall become dry, N his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil tha treasure of all pleasant vessels.
Samaria shall become desolate; 4 she has rebelled against her God: dey shall fall by tha sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, N their women wit child shall be ripped up.

14.text: O Israel, return 2 tha LORD ur God; 4 u have fallen by thine iniquity.
Take wit u words, N turn 2 tha LORD: say 2 him, Take away all iniquity, N receive us graciously: so will we render tha calves of our lips.
Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more 2 tha work of our hands, y’all r our gods: 4 in u tha fatherless finds mercy.
I will heal their backsliding, I will love ’em freely: 4 mine anger is turned away from him.
I will be as tha dew 2 Israel: he shall grow as tha lily, N cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
His branches shall spread, N his beauty shall be as tha olive tree, N his smell as Lebanon.
Dey dat live under his shadow shall return; dey shall revive as tha corn, N grow as tha vine: tha scent of it shall be as tha wine of Lebanon.
Ephraim shall say, What have I 2 do any more wit idols? I have heard him, N observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is ur fruit found.
Who is wise, N he shall understand dese things? prudent, N he shall know ’em? 4 tha ways of tha LORD r right, N tha just shall walk in ’em: but tha transgressors shall fall in it.
